content: Common Next.js App Router pitfalls: accessing window/document/localStorage during initial render of a client component before mount causes hydration mismatches; non-deterministic render output (Date.now(), Math.random(), locale-dependent formatting) differs between server and client render; hydration mismatch forces React to discard SSR output and re-render client-side, negating the SSR/SSG performance benefit; components are Server Components by default and must be explicitly marked 'use client' only where interactivity/browser APIs are needed - over-marking whole trees as client components increases JS bundle size unnecessarily.
